answer.reason: The verses tell of the living cherubim guarding Eden and of their actions in Ezekiel's vision, which add to the summary.

clauses.english: kept the way of the tree of life with a flaming sword
clauses.quote: to keep the way of the tree of life

clauses.english: gave fire from between them to the man clothed with linen
clauses.quote: put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen

clauses.english: mounted up from the earth with the glory of the God of Israel over them
clauses.quote: mounted up from the earth in my sight

doubts: The golden cherubim made for the mercy seat (EXO 25, EXO 37) and the mentions of the LORD dwelling between the cherubims (1SA 4:4, 2SA 6:2, 1CH 13:6, HEB 9:5) may be images or a different use of the name, so they were left out.
